python_program:
import json, sys
data = json.load(sys.stdin)
sys.path.insert(0, data["support"])
namespace = {"__name__": "more_itertools.more", "__package__": "more_itertools", "__file__": "<frozen-source>"}
exec(compile(data["source"], "<frozen-source>", "exec"), namespace)
cls = namespace["numeric_range"]
descending = data["operation"].endswith("_descending")
start, stop, step = (-1e16, -1e16 - 4, -1e-12) if descending else (1e16, 1e16 + 4, 1e-12)
if data["operation"].startswith("large_length"):
    r = cls(start, stop, step)
    n = len(r)
    correct = n > 0 and (start + (n - 1) * step > stop >= start + n * step if descending else start + (n - 1) * step < stop <= start + n * step)
    print(json.dumps({"passed": correct, "length": n, "boundary_matches_iteration_formula": correct}))
else:
    r = cls(start, stop, -0.1 if descending else 0.1)
    items = list(iter(r))
    query = start - 2 if descending else start + 2
    expected = items.index(query)
    actual = r.index(query)
    print(json.dumps({"passed": actual == expected, "index": actual, "expected_first_index": expected, "bounded_iteration_count": len(items)}))
